notes.cssparser-macros: V3: MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft, keep unmodified, print the source URL.
notes.selectors: V3: MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft, keep unmodified, print the source URL.

notes.ring: V7: Apache-2.0 AND ISC, ship all three license files.

notes.@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono: V10: OFL-1.1, the notice must accompany the font; never ship the font alone.
notes.@fontsource/sora: V11: OFL-1.1 design source, outlined into brandGeometry.ts, not shipped.
